svg.title: NeuroMesh measured latency
svg.desc: Horizontal log-scale bar chart of measured milliseconds. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding at 384 dimensions, p50 2.853 and p95 12.495 over 40 runs. all-distilroberta-v1 at 768 dimensions, p50 6.788 and p95 10.28 over 40 runs. Johnson-Lindenstrauss projection 768 to 384, p50 0.195 and p95 0.281 over 200 runs. HKDF plus AES-256-GCM envelope seal, p50 0.027 and p95 0.058 over 200 runs. The superseded PBKDF2 100k key derivation, p50 53.135 and p95 83.21 over 20 runs. Each row also shows a min to max whisker. Node v22.13.1 on win32, cold model load excluded.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

svg.text: milliseconds, log scale · Node v22.13.1 · win32 · steady state, cold model load excluded (MiniLM 197.3 ms, distilRoBERTa 665.5 ms) · CPU model not recorded
